note: Private family campground on 75 wooded acres about 2 mi north of downtown Eagle River, with a 12-ft-deep swim pond and water-play park, clubhouse snack bar and planned activities. ATVs may ride site to trail only. A third of the sites are seasonal. Renting a site requires a camping unit; day visitors pay $20. --Claude

PRICE GATE (private): passes on the base rate - the four 20-amp water/electric sites (11, 13, 96, 99) are $48 before 6% tax. The ordinary 30/50-amp sites are $64 and pond-side/sewer sites $69, so most nights cost over $50. gateways.py: none within 40 km (nearest Isle Royale NP 141 km).
LONG-STAY: 46 of 145 sites seasonal, about 99 (68%) sold by the night; posted nightly rates, site counts, online booking, Google 4.2 (192 reviews). Passes; no discouraging wording.

OHV FLAG (reviewer): home page markets 'Direct Access to ATV trails - ATV Friendly - ATV from site to trail'; rules allow ATVs site-to-trail only. Otherwise a general family campground (water park, 145 sites), so read as a general campground with an OHV side.
